title: Personal Website
summary: A zero-build, single-page portfolio for a developer: an animated static site on Vercel with two small serverless proxies for visit/like counts and the GitHub contribution graph.

nodes.label: Visitor
nodes.detail: Recruiter or peer browsing the portfolio, viewing projects, liking and messaging.

nodes.label: Single page (index)
nodes.detail: The one-page site: hero, work, journey, skills, awards, contact wallet and footer.

nodes.label: main.js bootstrap
nodes.detail: Entry module that runs each feature init in its own try/catch, then the preloader.

nodes.label: Hero and icons
nodes.detail: Kinetic name, typed SQL query, Manila clock and draggable tool-logo carousel.

nodes.label: Scroll and reveal
nodes.detail: Scroll progress, nav spy, scrubbed headings, pinned timeline journey.

nodes.label: Work showcase
nodes.detail: Pinned horizontal project track with screenshot galleries.

nodes.label: Lightbox and video
nodes.detail: Dialog viewers for award photos, project screenshots and demo videos.

nodes.label: GitHub activity
nodes.detail: Contribution calendar shown in the activity section and the wallet GitHub card.

nodes.label: Contact wallet
nodes.detail: Stacked contact passes for GitHub, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and email.

nodes.label: Message dialog
nodes.detail: Contact form dialog that posts the message via fetch.

nodes.label: Visit and like counters
nodes.detail: Shows totals, counts one visit and one like per browser, falls back to Abacus directly.

nodes.label: Theme and sfx
nodes.detail: Dark/light theme manager and Web Audio interface sounds.

nodes.label: Footer ASCII scene
nodes.detail: Animated lighthouse drawn in characters on the footer.

nodes.label: Browser storage
nodes.detail: localStorage and sessionStorage for theme, cached totals, visited and liked flags.

nodes.label: CSS tokens
nodes.detail: Design tokens for colour, type and motion, with a light-theme override.

nodes.label: /api/stats
nodes.detail: Vercel function that proxies visit and like counters and sets a one-year visited cookie.

nodes.label: /api/contributions
nodes.detail: Vercel function that scrapes the public GitHub contribution calendar into JSON, edge cached an hour.

nodes.label: Abacus counter API
nodes.detail: Free no-auth counter service holding portfolio views and likes.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.detail: Public contributions page that is the source of the activity graph.

nodes.label: Contributions fallback
nodes.detail: github-contributions-api.jogruber.de, used when the own function fails.

nodes.label: FormSubmit
nodes.detail: Third-party form endpoint that emails contact messages to the owner.

nodes.label: Vercel hosting
nodes.detail: Hosts the static files and runs the serverless functions.
